export const slug = text =>
  text
    .normalize('NFKD')
    .replace(/\p{M}/gu, '')
    .toLowerCase()
    // Lowercasing can reintroduce combining marks (e.g. 'İ' -> 'i̇').
    .normalize('NFKD')
    .replace(/\p{M}/gu, '')
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-')
    .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '');
